subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw handle UUID-like Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan keys when the selected model is the general `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` route?
rationale: The source and external guidance show a real general-versus-coding endpoint split, but only maintainer intent plus a credentialed vendor check can decide whether this should become automatic routing, a catalog addition, or an earlier diagnostic.

options.title: Validate Lite routing first
options.body: Run a redacted live Lite-key check against the general and Coding Plan endpoints, then implement the provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on Coding Plan
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for Coding Plan, add the correct Coding Plan model rows or model aliases and show a clear diagnostic when a Lite-looking key is used with a general model.

options.title: Treat this as user setup guidance
options.body: If no OpenClaw routing change is desired, document the supported model refs and make setup or runtime explain the unsupported key/model combination.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite routing first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live Lite-key check against the general and Coding Plan endpoints, then implement the provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled plugin ownership, setup flow, and runtime compatibility surfaces where the strongest history points to this owner.
